spans.s: श्रुत् (—˚) hearing.
स्रुत् (—˚) flowing with, discharging.

श्रुत॑ a. heard, learnt, mentioned, stated, named, known as,
famous, celebrated;
 n. hearing, learning, lore, tradition, (sacred)
knowledge.

श्रुतकर्मन् m. N. of a hero (lit. of celebrated
deeds).
श्रुतकाम a. desirous of learning.
श्रुतकीर्ति m. N. of a hero (of celebrated fame).
श्रुततस् adv. by hearsay.

श्रुतधर a. having a god memory (lit. keeping what is
heard).
श्रुतपूर्व a. heard (of) before, known by hearsay.
श्रुतबोध m. T. of a treatise on metres.

श्रुतवन्त् a. having heard;
 learned, scientific.
श्रुतवृत्त n. du. learning and virtue.

श्रुतवृत्ताढ्य a. endowed with learning and
virtue.

श्रुतवृ˚त्तोपपन्न a. endowed with learning
and virtue.

श्रुतशील n. du. learning and character;
 poss. ˚वन्त्.

श्रुतशीलसंपन्न a. endowed with learning and
character.
श्रुतश्रवस् m. a man's name.
1 श्रुतसेन॑ a. having a famous army.
2 श्रुत॑सेन m. N. of a serpent-demon etc.
श्रुता॑मघ a. having famous treasures.
श्रुतायु m. N. of sev. men.
श्रुता˚युस् m. N. of sev. men.

श्रु॑ति f. hearing, ear, sound, noise, report, hearsay, news,
tidings, (sacred) utterance or prescription, revelation, sacred text,
holy writ, the Veda;
 appellation, title.

स्रुति॑ f. flow, stream, gush;
 way, road.
श्रुतिकटु a. sounding harsh.
श्रुतिगोचर a. being within hearing.

श्रुतितस् adv. in the way of revelation^1;
 with regard or
according to (sacred) prescription.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.

श्रुतिद्वैध n. conflict or contradiction of two
sacred texts.
श्रुतिमन्त् a. having ears or possessing knowledge.
श्रुतिमहन्त् a. great in knowledge.
श्रुतिमार्ग m. = श्रुतिपथ.
श्रुतिशिरस् n. a chief passage of the holy scriptures.
श्रुतिशीलवन्त् v. श्रुतशीलवन्त्.
श्रु॑त्कर्ण a. having ears to hear.
श्रु॑त्य a. worth hearing.
स्रु॑त्य a. relating to a road.
श्रुत्युक्त a. said or taught in the sacred scriptures.
श्रुष् (श्रोषति श्रोष˚ते) ±आ hear. — Cf. श्रो॑षमाण.

श्रुष्टिम॑न्त् (f. ˚व॑री) obedient, officious,
zealous.
श्रुष्टीवन् (f. ˚व॑री) obedient, officious, zealous.
श्रूयमाणत्व n. the being heard.
स्रुग्दण्ड m. the handle of the Sruc.
स्रुघ्न m. N. of a town.
स्रु॑च् f. (nom. स्रु॑क्) a large sacrificial ladle.
स्रुच्य a. performed with the Sruc.
स्रुतजल a. dry (lit. having the water flowed off).
स्रुव॑ m. a small sacrificial ladle.
